notes.title: The Golfie 2.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Heya Golfers!

We hope you're as excited as we are about the new and improved, [b]Golfie 2.0[/b] - a major update that will redefine your Golfie experience. This new version focuses on getting you to the fun parts of the game faster than before. Say goodbye to those pesky energy penalties for falling into water or the void, and complete courses on par or better to earn exciting cards and perks! These changes allow you to further enjoy the best parts of the game, like attempting galaxy brain shots with crazy card combos! Knock yourselves out!

These updates and changes are a result valuable feedback from our amazing community to make the game even more enjoyable. However, we understand that some players loved the challenge of the old Golfie, so we’ve introduced a [b]Hardcore Mode[/b] that brings back that classic, more punishing experience for those who seek it!

[h1][b]Key Changes in Golfie 2.0[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]New Default 'Normal' Mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] No more energy penalties for falling into water or the void.
[*] Completing a level on par or better allows you to add a card to the deck.
[*] Getting a hole-in-one or better now lets you pick a perk instead of a card.
[*] Starting energy reduced to 3. Was previously 7.
[/list]
[h3][b]Hardcore Mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] The original 'normal' mode is moved to 'Hardcore', unlocked by winning at least one run.
[*] Leaderboards are now separated for normal and hardcore runs, along with endless mode separation. Endless mode can be toggled on/off in the leaderboard.
[/list]
[h3][b]New Map Features[/b][/h3]
These can be found on the map in addition to the current Random Challenge Encounters.
[list]
[*] [b]Coin:[/b] Awards 10 coins on completion.
[*] [b]Incinerator:[/b] Allows players to remove a card from their deck on completion.
[/list]
[h3][b]Multiplayer Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added new [b]DNF Timer[/b] that starts after the first player is in hole! Other players now need to finish within 60 seconds or they will fail the level! This is of course adjustable from within the multiplayer game settings.
[*][b]Sellout[/b] is now excluded by default from multiplayer games for balance, but can be re-enabled by adjusting the 'excluded items' list.
[/list]

[h3][b]Tutorial Expansion[/b][/h3]
The tutorial has been slightly expanded to include new hints about reactor heat and activating cards before shooting.

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
Tall grass now only limits X/Z velocity, making it easier to jump out.


In addition to the new gameplay changes, this update also includes numerous bug fixes, a few of the more common ones being:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tutorial will not start if the run is seeded.
[*] Fixed 'Retained Cards' pile displaying the wrong number of cards inside.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the refreshed gameplay, and as always, we welcome your feedback on our forums or [url=https://discord.com/invite/7JV2gPFpWu]Discord[/url]!

With lots of love as always,
Trihard Studio and Yogscast Games

notes.title: Huge 1.2 update is now live + 60% off during Deckbuilders Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello Golfiers!

We are thrilled to bring you this major update that introduces the new [b]Cave Ruins[/b] maps, adds new cards and challenge encounters, basic shot power rework, and more! 

This post outlines most of the new exciting stuff, so buckle up... 

[h3]New Cave Ruins Theme[/h3]
Dark, damp and mystic, these maps are a mixture of big open spaces and tight corners, riddled with ancient structures, traps, and dangerous cliffs. We are excited to add a 5th unique map type to the game, and we worked hard to make it cool and different!

[h3]Basic Power Rebalancing[/h3]
As you know we work hard to make Golfie the best game it can be, and we truly value all the great feedback the community has brought. One common point of feedback is that a basic putt is frustratingly weak. Or, quoting a reviewer, [i]"[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Venatius/]Your unmodified swing lands with the impact of an angel hair spaghetti noodle launched by the force of a baby exhaling[/url]"[/i]. While we made it this way by design with the intention of making the deck building aspect of the game shine, we recognize that it doesn't sit right with many players, so we have increased the basic putting strength, which in turn also affects the overall power the ball is launched with with one or more Power Shot cards, and so on. 

[h3]2 for 1 Power Shot Conversion[/h3]
We want the addition of new cards to the deck to be fun, but often you would find yourself missing basic cards like Power Shot if you're only drawing cool fancy cards, and that can sometimes be a point of frustration. We are happy to introduce [b]a new basic ability[/b] where you can swap any 2 cards in hand for a Power Shot once per turn. You can find the button right above the End Turn button!

[h3]3 New Cards[/h3]
Here's some more cards to discover on your runs:
[list]
[*] Gravity Repeater - Activate (hold) to increase the effect of gravity on the ball
[*] Quicksave - Activate to save the balls current position, then activate again to restore it
[*] Ramp - Place a ramp
[/list]

[h3]New Challenge Encounters[/h3]
These are the levels marked by a glitchy question mark, adding an additional challenge (and reward!) to the level. We are happy to introduce two more to the pool:
[list]
[*] Clumsy - Every third card played is instead discarded
[*] Confused - All card costs are randomized
[/list]

[h3]First Checkpoint Reset on the House[/h3]
Going for galaxy brain shots is in the DNA of Golfie, but sometimes the risk is simply too big if you end up in a bad spot and have to spend several shots getting back on track. There was always the ability to reset the ball to the last checkpoint, but it is pricey at -1 energy. Now, however, the first checkpoint reset each level is free, while subsequent resets still cost 1 energy!

[h3]Camera Improvements, UI Rework, and more...[/h3]
Many have voiced their frustration over the camera in tight quarters (often Dungeon levels), and we have finally found a way to improve the experience a bit, by increasing the FOV when trying to zoom out through walls, giving a wider view!

We've overhauled all the UI in the game, while also reconsidering the user experience and common interactions. I think you'll find that it looks much nicer and more coherent now! We have also added a "Difficulty Heads Up" popup that tries to communicate the challenging nature of the game to new players, making sure to mention the many ways to customize the game for a more casual experience if that is desired.

The ball also stops a bit faster now so you might find that you're lucky landing right on the edge instead of rolling all the way down now. There's also a bunch of bug fixes and other minor changes.

As always, we are very excited to hear your feedback, so don't hold back and voice your thoughts on [url=https://discord.gg/7JV2gPFpWu]the discord server[/url] or in the Steam forums!


Much love from us at Triheart Studio, and as always thanks for being here <3

notes.title: The Golfie 1.1 update is now live!
notes.notes:
Hey Golfers! 

We are excited to announce the Golfie 1.1 update! We have been working away at making the first major update the best it can be, and we are very excited to get it in your hands. We have had a lot of great feedback and reviews, and we're excited to release an update that should make the game accessible to even more players! In particular, those who prefer a more standard golfing experience will find themselves a nice addition with [b]Classic Mode[/b]!

[h2]Multiplayer Improvements[/h2]
With the 1.0 launch of Golfie we introduced multiplayer which adds a whole new dimension to the game. We have made some improvements to the multiplayer experience, designed to allow players to play Golfie the way the want with their friends. We have added game mode pre-sets:

[b]New game mode presets[/b]

[b]Normal[/b] - Golfie as you know it, but with more players.
[b] Draft[/b] - The full starting deck is drafted.
[b] Chaos[/b] - Settings are optimized for maximum chaos.
[b]Classic[/b] - A more traditional golfing experience, similar to other golf games.

We have also added expanded game mode settings allowing you to further tailor your multiplayer experience exactly how you want it.

You will now be able to customize:  
[list]
[*] Starting cards and perks
[*] How many cards are drafted at the beginning of the game
[*] If options from drafts and crystals are unique per player
[*] Whether abilities (like explosions from Impact Grenade, etc) affect other players 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768413/ace6dde4242b72923e1e1473e3c6730dc4086751.gif[/img]

We have also added a host of new content, so you can now enjoy a larger variety of new courses, allowing for even more replayability! 

We're also introducing multiple new cards and perks:

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
[b]Magnetize[/b] - Activate to become strongly magnetic a brief period.
[b]Long Tee[/b] - Spawn a long tee and shoot from a raised position.
[b]Coin Trap[/b] - Place a fake coin that explodes when picked up (multiplayer only).
[b]Flag Trap[/b] - Place a fake flag that damages the first ball to come close enough (multiplayer only)

[h2]New Perks[/h2]
[b]Lobster[/b] - Permanently add some height to shots.
[b]Generator[/b] - Add a temporary Power Shot card to the hand each round.
[b]Booster Pack[/b] - Add 3 random cards to the
[b]Refined Blue Crystal Shard[/b] - Pick a rare card and add it to the deck.

[h2]Bug fixes and Quality of life improvements[/h2]
As always we've been hard at work improving the game experience in general, in part thanks to the feedback of our awesome community! 
We have made a graphical overhaul of several modules with new props and set dressing, added new animations for showing what you get from eg. random card glitches or Booster Packs, and as always squashed a bunch of bugs!

We hope you enjoy the 1.1 update and we will be continuing to make Golfie a fantastic experience! If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/4CRYf4yMzg]join the community on discord[/url]!

The Golfie Team

notes.title: Update 3 - A New Foe
notes.notes:
The Boss Battle Update introduces the game’s final challenge. Meet [b]Golfoe[/b] – the (evil) next generation of Sentient Subordinate Servants™️ from Parsec Industries! Golfoe has some devious traps lined up for our hero – from scattering random explosive mines throughout the hole to patrolling the course with a lethal vision cone – creating the most lethal courses in the game. However, craft your deck with the challenge in mind and you’ll stand a chance of reaching the end, activating the missile launcher and turning Golfoe’s weapons against him.
 
Golfoe isn’t the only new addition: more adventurous players can now opt to tackle unique Challenge Encounters. These glitchy question marks on the map indicate that the hole also features a special global modifier, which will impact the way you will need to play this specific hole, and completing the challenge can bring a game-changing bonus for the rest of the run!

There are also two new perks to collect, and as always a bunch of QoL and bug fixes!
 
Now the Boss Battle Update is available, we are turning our full attention to [b]online multiplayer[/b] as we have promised – and we cannot wait to start showing that off. There will be opportunities to try this out before it goes public, so head over to the Discord and be the first to play
 
Until then – good luck against Golfoe, and we’ll see you on the fairway very soon.
 
Jacob, Sandra & the rest of the team
Triheart Studio

Please note that due to some last minute challenges, some localisation for the update is currently missing. It’s still fully playable, but text will default to English in places. We are seeking to address this as soon as we can. 

PS. You can read the full patch notes on the discord 👉 https://discord.gg/s7TpQzQgdW

notes.title: Update 2 - A New Challenge
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

Sandra and Jacob here with some news hot off the course: It’s time for a new update - [b]A New Challenge[/b]!

We’ve loved seeing all the creative ways you’ve approached the game since it launched. Seeing such spectacular shots shared via our Discord and social has brought huge smiles to our faces – and we can’t wait to see what you do with this new update. If you're not already there, we'd love to have you [url=https://discord.gg/4CRYf4yMzg]Discord[/url]: https://discord.gg/4CRYf4yMzg 

[u][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/u]: Before we get into the details, though: this update changes a few things behind the scenes which will make it incompatible with mid-run saves from previous versions.  So please make sure you finish your current run before you update, otherwise you will lose it. Don’t worry: everything else you’ve unlocked – cards, perks and cosmetics – along with your leaderboards will remain. So please make sure you are between runs before you update. If the game has already updated for you, you can change to the beta branch on Steam, where we've left the old build until you finish

But what an update – we’re thrilled to introduce some new cards, perks and cosmetics, along with a brand new ‘Challenge’ Mode, which creates custom runs featuring brand new modifiers. 

Thought you were getting good at the game? Well how about we change some of the rules? Head on over to the Challenge menu where you’ll find some brand new ways to play. 
The first Challenge is called ‘Bring The Heat’. Can you complete 18 holes when every card costs an additional Heat? It’s going to be tough – but, of course, there may be some cards or perks which will make life easier…
The second challenge is called ‘Bounce Ballad’ and… well, you’ll need to complete the first in order to find out more. 

Every week, we will unlock two new challenges, so make sure to check back each week for new and fun ways to play the game! Unlike Daily Challenges, you can compete in these as much as you like – and every Challenge has a separate leaderboard, giving you even more opportunity to show off  your prowess. 

In addition to the new challenge mode, we’re also unveiling:
New Card: Mimic - Select a card to create a temporary copy to your hand.
New Card: Investor - Pay 5 coins and pick a card from the draw pile.
New Perk: Reactor Core - Increase Reactor heat capacity by 1.
New Perk: Regenerative Membrane - Reduce max energy by 3 (to a minimum of 1), but recharge 1 energy when entering a new level.

We’ve of course also squashed a bunch of bugs and tidied up some things here and there! Like last update we’ve also wiped the global leaderboard, so get back in the ring if you want a place at the top! Additionally, Daily Challenges may now be played up to a week back, but no more! 

As ever, please do continue to share your shots via Discord and the socials. And look out for a teaser on the next update – it’s going to be a biggie, in more ways than one. 

Thanks so much for playing, 

Sandra and Jacob, Triheart Studio

notes.title: Update 1 - Fresh Supplies
notes.notes:
Hi all, 

Sandra and Jacob here with some hot-off-the-course news: we’ve just pushed our first major update live - ‘[b]Fresh Supplies[/b]’.

Thank you all so much for your support and enthusiasm during Golfie’s first month. We’ve been grinning from ear to ear reading your comments, thoughts and suggestions – and we’ve loved seeing people create card and perk synergies we’d never even considered. If you want to talk about deck and perk-building strategies with a wonderful community, we’d love to see you over on the [url=https://discord.gg/4CRYf4yMzg]Discord[/url]: https://discord.gg/4CRYf4yMzg 

But now, as the name suggests, it’s time for some new things to play with, so we’re thrilled to be able to introduce a host of new cards and perks for you to have fun with. 

[b]New Perks:[/b]
[list]
[*] Copy Machine - Upon pickup choose a card from your deck, then add another copy to your deck
[*] Glass Cannon - Reduce energy and max energy to 2, but increase Reactor capacity and draw amount by 2 (unique)
[*] Firewall - Prevent next energy loss
[*] Medical Nanobots – The ball is heavier, but recharges 1 energy after each level
[/list]

[b]New Cards: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fabricate – Discard two cards to add a temporary version of any card to your hand
[*] Boost Pad – Place a boost pad that drastically speeds up the ball in the chosen direction
[*] Energy Surge - Destroy all breakable objects within a certain distance
[*] Small Cache - Retain a card for next round
[*] Dive Bomb - Activate to cancel the balls current velocity and dive downwards until hitting the ground, resulting in a shockwave
[/list]

Plus, there’s an extra special, and much requested, item now available in the shop: 
Incinerator – Burn (remove) a card from your deck. Found in every shop, but increases in price after every purchase. 

These cards and perks will be added to the pool as you level up – though if you’ve already hit the required threshold, you’ll find them available right now. Go check out your Collection (renamed from ‘Memory Bank’) to see more. 

Along with this new content, we’ve adjusted some niggles and bugs behind the scenes, and continue to improve on the course generation and have updated controller support to make it a little easier to play if mouse and keyboard isn’t your preferred method. 

As ever, please do let us know your thoughts. There’s much more to come – and we’d love to hear what you would like to see, so we can make Golfie the best it can possibly be. 

Multiplayer is coming along nicely – more news on that soon. But until then: thanks once again for your support. We’ll see you on the fairway!

Much love!

Sandra, Jacob & the rest of the team at Triheart Studio <3
